messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "sender_address and recipient_address are swapped (parcel would go from Tartu to the customer).", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated **REQUIRE** norms by (1) swapping sender/recipient addresses (targeting `t0`), (2) failing to confirm declared value (omitted in tool call despite user intent), and (3) not ensuring contents were explicitly validated before creation. The action does not comply with `q12`'s address and confirmation rules."}}
